articles.summary: Global Legal Post covered how Intapp is now working with leading AI providers Anthropic and Harvey. Don Coleman, Intapp COO, is quoted in the article on the need for ethical safeguards in highly regulated industries like legal.
articles.title: Global Legal Post - Intapp strikes deals with Anthropic and Harvey

articles.summary: Intapp has partnered with FINARCH to accelerate AI-driven transformation for private markets firms –– specifically in the United States, Canada, APAC, and francophone regions. Through this partnership, FINARCH will resell Intapp DealCloud and use their deep expertise in implementation and digital transformation strategy to ensure firms achieve successful deployment and long-term business value.
articles.title: Intapp + FINARCH: accelerating AI adoption in private markets
